PAGASA has announced the onset of a short-lived La Niña in the tropical Pacific, warning of above-normal rainfall, possible flooding, and heightened tropical cyclone activity in the coming months.

“It is likely that this La Niña will continue at least until the December 2025 to February 2026 season, as suggested by several climate models,” PAGASA said.
